segments.text: Kyou's deputy. He's a strong man with an intimidating demeanor.
Toyotomi Hideyoshi's concubine and the mother of their child, Hideyori.
Toyotomi Hideyoshi and Yodo's son.
A child who Ueno Enju and Kuroyuki come across. He's a member of Azumaya's Troupe and travels often.
The leader of a troupe who Ueno Enju stumbles across a few times. He seems to be a polite man who cares for his workers.
Leader of the Zatoushu Clan.
The chief of the Kaga clan.
An injured boy who Enju came across while Goemon and Gekkamaru were fighting off a group of Zatoushu shinobi.
A wealthy man who Ueno Enju worked for while disguised as a maid.
Ueno Enju's mother. She died prior to the story starting.
She was the younger sister of Momochi Tanba, the chief of the Iga Clan. Following Iga's destruction, she brought all the survivors to Kouga.
A friendly girl in Azumaya's Troupe. Gekkamaru, Kuroyuki, and Ueno Enju came across her one day while she was "in a daze."
The master of a hidden village that is made up of many nukenin. He's kind and appears to have known Kagari at some point in his past.
The "second best" in the Tokugawa Shinobi.
The former leader of the Iga Clan.
The daughter of Kouga's leader, Ueno Kandou, and Iga's former leader Momochi Tanba's younger sister Kagari.
A symbol of peace between the two factions, she has been brought up carefully and has lived a sheltered life. Because of that, she is an innocent, unfamiliar with the ways of the world.
She aspires to contribute to her clan and her people, training diligently.

After losing his family at the age of three, Gekkamaru was adopted by the protagonist's family along with his younger brother Kuroyuki. Assigned to be the protagonist's bodyguard he has proven time and again to be loyal and steadfast.
He is known to be one of the most skilled and reliable ninja Kouga has.
He is completely devoted to his master and can sometimes be overprotective.
Gekkamaru's younger brother and the protagonist's foster brother. Right after he was born he and Gekkamaru were taken in by her family.
Cheerful, carefree and clever, he can also be quite cunning.
He was sent away on an extended mission when he was eight, and after 8 years, has finally returned.
The son of the late leader of Iga, Momochi Tanba, the protagonist's cousin.
After losing his family and clan in the Tenshou Iga War at the age of five, he joined Kouga with his surviving people.
Since he is the son of the Head Shinobi of the fallen Iga, he's naturally observant and calm.
His skills as a Shinobi are eminent in Kouga, as he's also a teacher for Enju and the others.
The Tokugawa Shinobi Group Leader who is known as the strongest ninja history has ever known.
He is a former Iga Shinobi who had left the village at the age of 12 to serve the Tokugawa household. From the moment he was born he was educated thoroughly to be a shinobi.
Always calm and collected, if it's for the mission he will not hesitate and be ruthless.
A notorious thief in the capital of Kyo. He steals from the rich to give to the poor and is popular among the townspeople.
During the day he uses the persona of "Gorou the Libertine".
Since the Council of the Five Elders is to be held in Kyo, Minister Ishida Mitsunari is desperate to catch him.

Uncharacteristically friendly and chatty for a ninja, Ennosuke is warmhearted, energetic and outgoing. He makes decisions quickly, but can be careless at times. His strength is in his speed. He is also Gekkamaru's best friend.

Proud and responsible, Kyara may be prickly with her words and seemingly snobbish, but is actually softhearted and gracious. She uses a Chigirigi as her weapon, which is a weapon similar to a Morningstar.

The youngest of Choujirou’s discuples, Kasumi is treated as the little sister of the group. She adores the protagonist and looks up to her, calling her “Sis”. Her skills as a shinobi are weak, but she is good at cooking and sewing.
A powerful lord in charge of the Kantou region. One of the Five Elders. He owns his own shinobi clan which is currently lead by Hattori Hanzou.
The protagonist’s father and leader of the Kouga clan. He received the Iga ninjas into Kouga after the Tenshou Iga War, despite their enmity in the past.
Japan’s great unifier who succeeded Oda Nobunaga after his death. Currently resides in Fushimi castle. His son Hideyori, born of his concubine Yodo, is the apple of his eye.
Hideyoshi Toyotomi’s right-hand man and Minister of Civil Administration.
He is also a confidant to Hideyoshi’s concubine, Yodo.
